summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from hardcoded bare IP with TLS verification disabled
details: The postinstall lifecycle script downloads a.tgz archive over HTTPS from a hardcoded bare IP address (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/), extracts it, chmods the extracted binary 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode where it is later invoked via the package's `onecode` bin entry. The HTTPS request is issued with `rejectUnauthorized: false`, and redirects are followed with the same flag, so certificate validation is fully disabled. No hash or signature verification is performed on the fetched bytes. The download host is a bare IP unrelated to any npm publisher domain, and the fetched payload is opaque native code executed automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
